SELECT 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total_s,
        's' AS sale_type_s
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total_w,
        'w' AS sale_type_w
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year) AS t_s_firstyear,
    (SELECT 
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total_s,
        's' AS sale_type_s
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year) AS t_s_secyear,
    (SELECT 
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total_w,
        'w' AS sale_type_w
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year) AS t_w_firstyear,
    (SELECT 
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total_w,
        'w' AS sale_type_w
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year)
WHERE 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
    AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
    AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
    AND t_s_firstyear.sale_type_s = 's'
    AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type_w = 'w'
    AND t_s_secyear.sale_type_s = 's'
    AND t_w_secyear.sale_type_w = 'w'
    AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 1999
    AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 1998
    AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 1999
    AND t_s_firstyear.year_total_s > 0
    AND t_w_firstyear.year_total_w > 0
    AND CASE 
        WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total_w > 0 THEN t_w_secyear.year_total_w / t_w_firstyear.year_total_w 
        ELSE 0.0 END > CASE 
        WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total_s > 0 THEN t_s_secyear.year_total_s / t_s_firstyear.year_total_s 
        ELSE 0.0 END
ORDER BY 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
